mapper.select: SELECT r.reply_no, r.board_no, r.community_account_no, r.reply_content, r.reply_status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, a.nickname FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD_REPLY r INNER JOIN TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT a ON a.community_account_no = r.community_account_no WHERE r.board_no = #{board_no} AND r.reply_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.reply_no ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.reply_no, r.board_no, r.community_account_no, r.reply_content, r.reply_status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, a.nickname FROM TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD_REPLY r INNER JOIN TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT a ON a.community_account_no = r.community_account_no WHERE r.board_no = #{board_no} AND r.community_account_no = #{community_account_no} AND r.reply_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.reply_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMUNITY_BOARD_REPLY ( board_no, community_account_no, reply_content, reply_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{board_no}, #{community_account_no}, #{reply_content}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
